notes_for_editor: Register facts are direct. No tower-specific history was found: the two web searches returned only general Alberta lookout material and a lake sediment study. The 2009 Alberta lookout towers map text does not contain COWPAR, so it gives no earlier history. The brief's access value 'closed' is not supported; the register gives active with access mode fly, so it is corrected to restricted. Reading 'fly' as reached by air follows the Adair record and is not defined in any source. Register query uses NAME LIKE '%COW%' because NAME LIKE '%COWPAR%' returned HTTP 500 on the server. Fact-check 2026-10-20: the access mode 'fly' is not defined in any source, so the story no longer glosses it as air access.
